text:
Kori (Growth): Need a small 'launch sizzle' kit for next Tuesday's benchmark announcement. Tight: final assets Mon EOD. Keep editable for last-minute copy.

Riley (Design): What's in the kit? sizes + motion?

Kori (Growth): Minimal set: 3 social sizes (1200x628, 1080x1080, 1200x675), email hero (1200x400), 600x600 micro-GIF (2.5s), 600x200 partner banner, and 1-page PDF one-sheet. Also 3 subject-line variants + 3 CTAs.

Maya P.: Stats to call out: "avg latency: 42ms/token" and "~2x cost vs baseline". Keep language short and factual.

Riley (Design): Deliver PNG+SVG for statics, GIF+MP4 for motion, retina exports, and a Figma file with components. Will include a README with color/font tokens.

Sam O.: Brand constraints: primary blue + neutrals only; provide white-background press variants and dark-mode versions. Add 1px safety margin for badges.

Leo (Design Ops): Figma must use component instances per size and consistent layer names. Accessibility: text contrast >= 4.5:1. Exports named: sizzle-YYYYMMDD-<asset>-v1.{png,svg,gif,mp4}.

assets-bot: Starter Figma uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/launch-sizzle.

Kori (Growth): Timeline again: announcement Tue 9am PT. Mon EOD handoff preferred. Tag me on any blockers.

Riley (Design): I'll post wireframes today, comps Tue AM, final Mon EOD. Tagging reviewers on upload.

Maya P.: Draft subjects: 1) "New benchmarks: faster & cheaper" 2) "See latency & cost wins" 3) "Benchmark snapshot: speed + savings"

Kori (Growth): CTA options: [View report], [See pricing & perf], [Watch demo]. We'll pick at handoff.

Riley (Design): Noted — keeping thread short, will DM if blocked.
